title: Mirror Descent at the Edge of Stability
abstract: arXiv:2611.29043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many deep learning settings, gradient descent has been shown to operate at the edge of stability -- a regime where the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers around $2/\eta$. We study this phenomenon in mirror descent, a generalization of gradient descent. As mirror descent is non-Euclidean, existing explanations of the edge of stability phase do not extend to this setting. We generalize the existing notion of sharpness to introduce mirror sharpness, which measures the curvature of the loss with respect to the mirror potential. Empirically, we observe that the mirror sharpness hovers slightly above the $2/\eta$ threshold. Furthermore, we derive a dual central flow ODE for mirror descent that models iterates in continuous time at the onset of edge of stability. Our ODE provides insights into the difficulties of extending existing arguments for why sharpness stabilizes at $2/\eta$ from gradient descent to mirror descent in full g

translated_title: 稳定性边缘处的镜像下降
translated_abstract: 在许多深度学习场景中，梯度下降已被证明运行在稳定性边缘——即损失函数Hessian矩阵的最大特征值徘徊在 $2/\eta$ 附近的区域。我们在镜像下降（梯度下降的一种推广）中研究这一现象。由于镜像下降是非欧几里得的，现有的对稳定性边缘阶段的解释并不能直接推广到这一设定。我们推广了现有的锐度（sharpness）概念，引入了“镜像锐度”，用于衡量损失相对于镜像势函数的曲率。在实验上，我们观察到镜像锐度徘徊在 $2/\eta$ 阈值稍上方。此外，我们推导了镜像下降的对偶中心流ODE，以连续时间方式建模稳定性边缘发生时的迭代过程。我们的ODE为理解将“锐度为何稳定在 $2/\eta$”的现有论证从梯度下降推广到完全一般的镜像下降所面临的困难提供了洞察。
tldr: 该论文提出“镜像锐度”概念并推导对偶中心流ODE，首次将梯度下降的稳定性边缘现象研究推广到非欧几里得的镜像下降设定，并实验发现镜像锐度徘徊在 $2/\eta$ 阈值稍上方。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of mirror sharpness and derives a dual central flow ODE, extending the edge of stability analysis from gradient descent to the non-Euclidean mirror descent setting, with empirical observations showing that mirror sharpness hovers slightly above the 2/η threshold.
